critical_code_review_comments: payments.py _get_stripe_config sets the process-global 'stripe.api_key = secret_key' on every call. If two concurrent requests use different keys (e.g., during rotation), there is a small race window. Acceptable for current single-tenant setup; consider using per-call stripe.StripeClient(api_key=...) if multi-tenant support is added.
payment-status endpoint (line 223) awaits _get_stripe_config() but discards the tuple; fine, side-effect is setting stripe.api_key. A short comment there would help future readers.
